clue.text: Silly riddle I cut out to set before infantile character

indicators.note: set before puts the little word to at the front of the rest

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: silly suggests the trimmed word is being muddled into a new order
cut out tells us the letter I is removed from the word riddle

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone drops a daft riddle to make way for a childish figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Silly' looks like it describes the riddle, but it is the anagram signal, working on what is left once 'cut out' drops the I; 'set before' puts the little word in front.
explanation.definitionFit: A small child just learning to walk is the very picture of an infantile person.

clue.text: Trade in lots of vehicles

definitions.meaning: to deal in goods, often illicitly
the cars and lorries on a road

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both dealing in goods and the movement of many cars along roads.

clue.text: Gifts for the people at the party

indicators.note: at places the peoples beside the party, so the party word comes first

parts.note: a do is a party
nations are peoples

explanation.surface: Presents handed out to guests at a celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: Charitable contributions are presents given freely, so both name things bestowed.

clue.text: Freedom to hand down to posterity

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both permission to be absent and to bequeath something to heirs.

clue.text: Perform surgery on diseased tip of cypress trees

indicators.note: diseased trees are in a bad way, so the letters are rearranged
the tip of a word is its first letter

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A tree surgeon tends sickly cypresses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tip of' gives C from cypress; 'diseased' rearranges C with TREES.
explanation.definitionFit: To excise part of an organ or tissue surgically is to operate on it.

clue.text: Tried putting a representative in the transport

indicators.note: in tells us the first pieces go inside the vehicle word

parts.note: a sled is a means of transport over snow
MP, Member of Parliament, is an elected representative

explanation.surface: Someone tests the idea of seating a politician in a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: To taste or test something is to try it out.

clue.text: With this top dressing on grave, rose starts to make a showing

annotationWithheld.why: With this top dressing on grave, rose starts to make a showing: SOMBRE (grave) + RO needs 'rose starts' to give two letters, and 'to make a showing' has no job; the clue as held looks garbled
annotationWithheld.clue: With this top dressing on grave, rose starts to make a showing

clue.text: Materials replacing horsehair

indicators.note: replacing hints that the letters are put back in a different order

explanation.surface: Fabrics are swapped out for horsehair stuffing.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally, a female horse's tail is a hank of horse hair.

clue.text: Round chap's head stuck in chimney? Get the doctor!

indicators.note: stuck in places the round shape and the head letter inside the chimney word

parts.note: lum is a Scottish and northern word for chimney
O is round in shape

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A man's head is stuck in a chimney and someone calls for medical help.
explanation.walkthrough: LUM is Scots for a chimney; O and C go inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A stand-in physician covers for the regular practitioner, so is the doctor you get.

clue.text: Weapon raised after journalist nodded

indicators.note: after places the weapon before the journalist
in a down clue raised means the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: a sword is a weapon
ED, editor, is the crossword journalist

explanation.surface: A journalist dozed off once a weapon was lifted.
explanation.definitionFit: To doze off is to nod, as a sleepy head drops.

clue.text: Books of interest to gardeners

parts.note: yearly books, such as children's ones issued each Christmas, share a name with plants that live one season

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both yearbooks and plants that complete their life in a single year.

clue.text: Country ale once brewed in Britain, paradoxically

definitions.text: ale once brewed in Britain, paradoxically
definitions.meaning: a strong ale formerly brewed at Levens Hall in Cumbria, odd for a beer named after a foreign land

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a North African nation and also a historic strong English ale.

clue.text: He's taken his annual package tour

definitions.text: He's taken his annual package tour

parts.words: He's taken his annual package tour
parts.note: not a holiday trip but a yearly round delivering parcels on Christmas Eve

explanation.definitionFit: Santa makes a yearly journey delivering parcels, a literal package tour.

clue.text: Cold roast sliced for them

annotationWithheld.why: Cold roast sliced for them: C + anagram of ROAST fits, but 'them' gives no definition of Croats; a defining word looks lost in the clue as held

clue.text: A ketch at sea gets fish for the author

indicators.note: at sea means confused, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: a ray is a flat fish

explanation.surface: A sailing boat out on the water lands a fish for a writer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at sea' rearranges A KETCH to THACKE; William Makepeace THACKERAY wrote Vanity Fair.
explanation.definitionFit: The Victorian novelist who wrote Vanity Fair is a famous writer.

clue.text: Opened with fish in place of oysters

indicators.note: in puts the fish word inside the place word

parts.note: oysters are farmed in a bed
a roach is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Something was opened with fish substituted for oysters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in place of' looks like a substitution, but 'place of oysters' is a BED with the fish inside.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise a subject or tap a cask is to open it.

clue.text: Turn up ring bell then put present outside — it's for th gardener

indicators.note: put outside places the present word around the rest

parts.note: here means present

indicators.note: in a down clue turn up means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: O is ring-shaped
taken as written

explanation.surface: Instructions for ringing a bell before giving a gift to a gardener.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'Turn up' reads the ring and bell upwards, giving LLEBO; HELLEBORE, the Christmas rose, is a garden plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The Christmas rose is a winter-flowering plant grown in gardens.

clue.text: One of the team recently visiting by air

definitions.text: One of the team recently visiting by air

parts.words: One of the team recently visiting by air
parts.note: one of the animals drawing Santa's sleigh through the sky at Christmas

explanation.definitionFit: Santa's sleigh is pulled through the sky by a team of these antlered animals.

clue.text: Frenchman is abducted in error

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for monsieur
abducted means taken

explanation.surface: A Frenchman is kidnapped by mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: Wrong or mistaken both describe someone who has got something wrong.

clue.text: Mother's pet dog

parts.note: ma is mother
a pet is a fit of sulking, as is a tiff

explanation.walkthrough: 'pet' here is not an animal but a sulk or huff, like a TIFF.
explanation.definitionFit: A mastiff is a large powerful breed of guard dog.

clue.text: Cruising, likely to moor here

indicators.note: cruising suggests the letters are wandering about

explanation.surface: Boaters on a cruise expect to tie up at this spot.
explanation.walkthrough: ILKLEY is a Yorkshire town famous for Ilkla Moor; 'moor' is not about mooring a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: The Yorkshire spa town gives its name to Ilkley Moor.

clue.text: Assumed it must result in a certain loss of face

definitions.text: Assumed it must result in a certain loss of face

parts.words: Assumed it must result in a certain loss of face
parts.note: a garment which, once put on, hides most of the wearer's face

explanation.definitionFit: A Muslim woman's veil covers the face below the eyes, so the face disappears from view.

clue.text: Let loose when adjacent keys move in combination

parts.note: E and F are neighbouring musical keys
to fuse is to join together

explanation.surface: Something breaks free when neighbouring piano keys are played together.
explanation.definitionFit: To pour forth or emit is to release something freely.

clue.text: Small gifts with legs?

parts.note: little presents put in Christmas hosiery, and also legs, which fill out hosiery

explanation.definitionFit: Small presents fill out a Christmas sock, just as legs fill out hosiery.

clue.text: Take lid off chest to disclose present

indicators.note: removing the lid of a word means dropping its first letter

parts.note: a coffer is a chest

explanation.surface: Lift a chest's lid to reveal a gift inside.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold out something for acceptance is to present it.

clue.text: Oil pollution engineers found in the river

indicators.note: pollution suggests the letters are spoiled into a new order

parts.note: RE stands for the Royal Engineers

explanation.surface: Engineers discover an oil slick in a river.
explanation.definitionFit: The longest waterway in France flows past many châteaux.

clue.text: Policemen recruited — large numbers of them

explanation.definitionFit: Joining the police puts you into the force, and turning out in great numbers is turning out en masse.

clue.text: Suit's a Parisian shape I fit into

indicators.note: fit into places the letter I inside the other pieces

parts.note: un is French for a
a form is a shape

explanation.surface: A French suit is shaped to fit the speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: Matching outfit worn by a team or force is a type of suit.

clue.text: Has a fresh excursion planned for New Year

indicators.note: new suggests the letters are made over in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Someone books a new trip for the coming year.
explanation.walkthrough: 'planned' is part of the definition; 'New' rearranges FOR YEAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A raider or adventurer is someone who makes sallies or excursions, a description of the person.

clue.text: Sheep takes bottle top from mount in poor condition

parts.note: a ewe is a female sheep
the neck is the top part of a bottle

explanation.surface: A sheep pinches the top of a bottle from a scraggy horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin concave neck is a defect in a horse, a riding animal in bad shape.
